title: Solomon's Gold: Where Was Ophir?
notes: Talent weight given as a range (roughly 26-34 kg per talent). Great Zimbabwe myth stated plainly in beats 10-12.

beats.text: Where did Solomon's gold come from?
First Kings nine: Solomon builds a fleet at Ezion-geber, on the Red Sea shore.
beats.say: First Kings nine: Solomon builds a fleet at EZ-ee-on GEH-ber, on the Red Sea shore.

beats.text: King Hiram of Tyre sends sailors who know the sea to crew it.
beats.say: King HIGH-ram of Tire sends sailors who know the sea to crew it.
beats.label: HIRAM'S SAILORS

beats.text: They return from Ophir with four hundred twenty talents of gold.
beats.say: They return from OH-fur with four hundred twenty talents of gold.

beats.text: Roughly eleven to fourteen tonnes, depending on which talent standard you use.
beats.label: 11-14 TONNES?

beats.text: First Kings ten adds almug wood and precious stones, also carried from Ophir.
beats.say: First Kings ten adds AL-mug wood and precious stones, also carried from OH-fur.

beats.text: What's not proven: where Ophir was. The Bible never says.
beats.say: What's not proven: where OH-fur was. The Bible never says.

beats.text: Guess one: southern Arabia, around Yemen. Guess two: India's western coast, a far longer voyage.
Guess three: East Africa, far down the coast.
In eighteen seventy-one, explorer Karl Mauch linked Great Zimbabwe to Ophir.
beats.say: In eighteen seventy-one, explorer Karl Mowkh linked Great Zim-BAB-way to OH-fur.
beats.label: GREAT ZIMBABWE

beats.text: But Shona-speaking peoples built Great Zimbabwe, around the eleventh to fifteenth centuries AD, about two thousand years after Solomon.
beats.say: But SHOH-na-speaking peoples built Great Zim-BAB-way, around the eleventh to fifteenth centuries A D, about two thousand years after Solomon.

beats.text: The Solomon link is a colonial-era myth, not archaeology.
Arabia, India or East Africa: where would you place Ophir?
beats.say: Arabia, India or East Africa: where would you place OH-fur?

youtube.title: Solomon's Gold: Where Was Ophir? 🗺️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Four hundred twenty talents of gold, and a Bible that never names the place. Arabia, India or East Africa?
The location of Ophir is not proven; the Great Zimbabwe link is a colonial-era myth.
#Ophir #KingSolomon #BibleHistory #MythUnearthed
